title: Momino Haidare Karrar ka matam karlo
body:
Haye Ali, Ya Ali..(8)
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(3)
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..
<<DIVIDER>>
Han Mohammad ke alamdaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khaak udaao ke ali, sher e khuda maare gaye..(2)
baazu e Ahmed e mukhtar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jiske darr se na gaya, khali sawali koi..(2)
us sakhi sahib e qirdaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Joke pancho'n mein bhi hai, baara imamo mein bhi hai..(2)
saare nabiyo ke madadgaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Har wali kehta hai ye, karke ali ka matam..(2)
mere aaqa mere sarkaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Milke jibreel ke, ustad ka pursa dedo..(2)
sahib e duldul o talwaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Apne qatil ko diya, jisne ke jaam e shiree'n..(2)
kausari jaam ke mukhtaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kufa o karbobala, shaam se aati hai sadaa..(2)
ujde sadaat ke gulzaar ka matam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino Haider e karrar ka matam karlo..(2)
